[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Pomodoro sub-bullet moves and named Pomodoros[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]`<ctrl+shift+m>` on a Pomodoro sub-bullet moves that bullet — and, [/#D7D7AF]

[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]just below the current one, and the Pomodoro glossary entry [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]documents named Pomodoros and this keymap.[/#D7D7AF]
